def predict(history, action):
    grid = np.array(history.frames[-1], dtype=np.int8)
    kind = int(action.kind)
    if kind == 6:
        row = int(action.row)
        col = int(action.col)
        # Attempt to move agent (blue 9) and place item (yellow 11)
        agent_pos = np.where(grid == 9)
        item_pos = np.where(grid == 11)
        if len(agent_pos[0]) > 0 and len(item_pos[0]) > 0:
            agent_r, agent_c = agent_pos[0][0], agent_pos[1][0]
            item_r, item_c = item_pos[0][0], item_pos[1][0]
            # Move agent towards item
            if row >= agent_r and col >= agent_c:
                new_agent_r = min(row, agent_r)
                new_agent_c = min(col, agent_c)
            elif row <= agent_r and col <= agent_c:
                new_agent_r = max(row, agent_r)
                new_agent_c = max(col, agent_c)
            elif row >= agent_r and col <= agent_c:
                new_agent_r = row
                new_agent_c = max(col, agent_c)
            elif row <= agent_r and col >= agent_c:
                new_agent_r = max(row, agent_r)
                new_agent_c = col
            else:
                # Fallback if row/col don't align with agent
                new_agent_r = agent_r
                new_agent_c = agent_c
            # Place item at target
            new_grid = grid.copy()
            new_grid[item_r, item_c] = 0
            new_grid[new_agent_r, new_agent_c] = 9
            new_grid[new_agent_r, new_agent_c] = 11
            # Update agent position
            new_grid[agent_r, agent_c] = 0
            new_grid[new_agent_r, new_agent_c] = 9
            return {"next_grid": new_grid, "game_state": "NOT_FINISHED", "level_delta": 0, "memory": {}}
    return {"next_grid": grid, "game_state": "NOT_FINISHED", "level_delta": 0, "memory": {}}

def goal_value(history):
    grid = np.array(history.frames[-1], dtype=np.int8)
    # Calculate normalized distance to goal (item 11)
    agent_pos = np.where(grid == 9)
    item_pos = np.where(grid == 11)
    if len(agent_pos[0]) > 0 and len(item_pos[0]) > 0:
        agent_r, agent_c = agent_pos[0][0], agent_pos[1][0]
        item_r, item_c = item_pos[0][0], item_pos[1][0]
        dist = abs(item_r - agent_r) + abs(item_c - agent_c)
        grid_size = grid.size
        norm_dist = dist / max(grid_size, 1)
        # Goal value decreases with distance
        goal_val = max(0.0, 1.0 - norm_dist)
        return goal_val
    return 0.0
